paper_title: Revised constraints and Belle II sensitivity for visible and invisible axion-like particles
suggested_experiment_name: ALP photon coupling combined constraints (Dolan et al.)
notes: Paper presents revised constraints and Belle II projected sensitivity for ALP-photon coupling g_agamma vs ALP mass (keV-GeV). Coupling type is clearly AxionPhoton (g_agamma in GeV^-1). However, no numerical tables are provided; all results are shown in figures (Fig 2, 4, 7) without extractable tabulated values. Confidence reduced due to lack of extractable numerical data points. Limits given at 90% CL (collider/beam dump bounds at 95% but stated to be imperceptibly different). | Vision: Left panel of Figure 2 (photon coupling, g_aγZ=0). Lower boundary of the combined excluded region. At low mass (keV-MeV) the floor is set by HB stars (~6e-6) and SN1987A; below ~0.5 MeV the strong SN1987A (a→γγ) bound dips to ~3e-9 around a few MeV, then rises steeply toward higher masses. Values read from log-log plot, approximate. Coupling g_agamma in GeV^-1. | Calibration: Spot-check calibration: verify/stage2 ratio=4.0x
